I need to find the distinct declarations of the method "Close" across the backend, likely in Go files. I think I should search through the codebase to gather information about how many times "Close" is declared. It seems like I need to look for patterns in the Go files, which will help me keep track of all occurrences. Let's see what I can uncover with this search!

args.command: shopt -s globstar nullglob; for f in **/*.go; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; awk '/func \([^)]*\) Close\(/ {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0}' "$f"; done
